Detailed feature list: $280/mo per provider, cloud-based, 4/5 stars (92 reviews). Lists clinical documentation, e-Rx, patient portal, PM, RCM, reporting, lab integration, e-signature. Supports Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS, Android.

Review covering key features: clinical documentation with voice recognition, RCM module, HL7/FHIR interoperability, patient portal, telehealth, analytics dashboards, HIPAA compliance with encryption and audit trails.
4/5 stars, 92 reviews. CCHIT and MACRA certified, ranked top 10 by KLAS. Suitable for solo to large hospital practices. Highlights e-Rx, patient portal, customizable templates.
User reviews (2026). Mixed feedback — praise for functionality and customization, complaints about customer support responsiveness, outdated UI, and a reported security incident.
